turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Kind of tired, honestly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey, quick one. The garden centre has peat free compost and normal compost. Does it matter which?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It matters for the environment. Peat comes from bogs that take thousands of years to form, so peat free is the kinder choice.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Different question. My wrist has been aching after long gaming sessions.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sorry to hear that. Does it hurt during the day too, or only after playing?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Mostly after. It's getting worse.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then let's act on it. A full week off to rest it, or shorter sessions with breaks?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Come look at this.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, sorry Moshi, give me a sec.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, can you say that again? The blender was on.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I said do you want a smoothie too.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sam, did you see the forecast for tomorrow?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, thunderstorms after three.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ugh. Do you still want to do the hike?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: We could start really early and be down by noon.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How early is really early?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Like leave the house at six.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Fine, but you're making the coffee.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: All sorted, Moshi. Pick up where you were.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Your aching wrist. Rest it completely, or cut down the sessions?
